newsitem.title: USA: Dart Group Corp Q3 sales rise 1.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Dart Group Corp Q3 sales rise 1.4 pct.

text.p: Dart Group Corp said on Tuesday that total sales for Crown Books Corp, Trak Auto Corp and Total Beverage increased 1.4 pct to $157,816,000 for the 13 weeks ended October 31 compared with a year earlier.
It said sales rose 4.4 percent to $478,142,000 for the 39-week period compared with a year ago.
Comparable store sales decreased 0.3 percent for the 39-week period and fell 3.7 pct for the 13 weeks ended October 31, from the same period a year ago.
Dart owns about 52 percent of Crown Books, 67 percent of Trak Auto, 100 percent of Total Beverage and 50 percent of Shoppers Food Warehouse.
